mapper.sql: id, user_id, session_id, title, message_count, last_message_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: select from chat_session where user_id = #{userId} and session_id = #{sessionId}
select from chat_session where user_id = #{userId} order by last_message_at desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into chat_session (user_id, session_id, title, message_count, last_message_at, created_at, updated_at) values (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{title}, #{messageCount}, #{lastMessageAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: update chat_session set message_count = message_count + 2, last_message_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} where id = #{id}
update chat_session set title = #{title}, updated_at = #{now} where id = #{id}
